set.body: Follow-up diagnosis and fresh mitigation confirmation are retained under docs/verification/gls-ar2-factor-diagnosis-20261008/. Homogeneous short-run global/run pooling passes original margins on JVM and JS, but short-run voxelwise remains failed and doubled-run voxelwise still fails joint-F equivalence (148/2048, 90% CI [.063069,.082384] outside [.02,.08]); its other criteria pass. Paired diagnostic separates estimated-filter variance underreporting from the known-filter censor-reset approximation. No numerical covariance indexing bug was found. Design a typed, scientifically justified inference treatment for estimated covariance and, separately, a continuity-aware censor/noise policy. Avoid guessing effective df or scaling standard errors until theory and public-seam fixtures justify it. Include homogeneous and heterogeneous AR truth, declare fresh protocols and held-out confirmation streams before outcomes, retain all refusals and adverse cases, and require JVM/JS parity plus complete R interval/bootstrap acceptance. The spent original and follow-up confirmation streams remain negative where observed; pooled recommendations must not be generalized to heterogeneous noise.
set.title: Voxelwise FGLS inference: model covariance-estimation uncertainty and censor continuity
